notes.title: Handyman Fantasy Demo is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Ding-ding! 🎉
The Handyman Fantasy demo is now available for early access!

Although the Steam Next Fest officially starts next Tuesday,
we decided to release the demo today so everyone can enjoy the game over the weekend 🤗
The demo is now live on our Steam page—curious gentlemen, come give it a try!
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43526948/40250d6529ad408140ca5cc7af0997247d778588.png[/img]


🛠️ Demo Content Includes:

[list]
[*] All currently available heroines
[*] Lewd Level available: LV0–LV1
[*] Dungeon Levels: D to B
[*] Some shop items
[*] Some upgradable skills
[/list]
⚠️ Demo progress will not carry over to the full version

We’ve run many tests, but due to our limited team size, there may still be bugs.
If you encounter any issues while playing, please leave us a comment—we’ll fix it ASAP!

Wishing you all a great time with the game~ 💕


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690010/Handyman_Fantasy/
💖 And don’t forget to add us to your wishlist!

notes.title: The Steam page for our new game is now live!
notes.notes:
Long time no see~ Hello, everyone!
Our sequel, "Handyman Fantasy", now has its Steam page open!

For those who have been following us, you probably know that we've actually been developing this new game for over a year now. However, due to the review process, the release of the Steam page was delayed until now.

From now on, all updates related to the development progress will also be posted on the new game's Steam page!

If you're interested, please add "Handyman Fantasy" to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2690010/Handyman_Fantasy/

notes.title: The DLC and artbook set will be released simultaneously on May 19th
notes.notes:
[h3]
The majority of the content for the free DLC has already been completed, and it was originally planned to be released this week. However, several bugs were discovered during testing, which required fixing. Therefore, we must postpone the release date by one week to May 19th. We are very sorry for the delay and inconvenience this may cause.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/f8ef898aea4a857382a82515069d5c222bd0f6dc.png[/img]

In addition, we will be releasing a digital art collection on Steam on the 19th, which includes character designs and sketches. This collection provides additional content not mentioned in the game and will not affect the gameplay experience if not purchased. However, if you would like to support us, please consider making a purchase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/bd3cd10e3fe35a236d4ad81ed13f9767efd8ddfc.png[/img]
Lastly, we have news regarding DLsite. We are planning to release a Demo version of the game on the platform in the near future, and we will do our best to ensure that the full game is released as planned in June, as mentioned on the announcement page.
[/h3]

notes.title: introduce the gameplay of the additional content!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We don't want you to forget about us, so just popping in to say hi and introduce some new gameplay features we're planning to add!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/3d4fc5adfbb5900e00d22e38193b153634a11cc2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/9d51ecbf19522c391ccb619538d02942b474589e.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] When someone approaches the counter, the blue bar increases, and when the store manager walks by, it increases significantly. 
[*] The red bar will have different standby actions in different stages. 
[*] You can adjust the transparency of the counter at any time.
[/list]
Try to make the salesgirl climax without arousing suspicion!
After completing a task under the counter, a new, more erotic game will be unlocked. Hehe... We'll leave it to you to experience it firsthand.

The gameplay of the Mystery Store is all about offense and defense!
The goal is to try not to ejaculate too soon under the various BDSM from the salesgirl.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/a1a6d868b17b7772cc45b421b36308b13f5aef3f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/6c31a89df24a5adbac71acc80029745decf4af74.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] You must click the CLICK button continuously to keep the stick within the comfortable zone, and the red bar will increase. 
[*] The comfortable zone will change positions with progress, and the area will shrink.
[*] During the process, you will randomly enter the endurance section, where the circles appearing in the nine-square grid must be eliminated within a fixed time.
[*] If you fail to eliminate them within the time limit, you will ejaculate and fail the task.
[/list]
If you can't control yourself and ejaculate prematurely, the salesgirl will look down on you with contempt.
Like the regular store, after completing a task, you can unlock the second stage of the game, and the salesgirl's attack will be even more intense...

[h3]That's the new gameplay features we plan to add in the next update.
However! This is not all. Some other content that hasn't been mentioned will also be added in the next update!

We're trying pretty hard, and hopefully the new content can be launched in early May. Thank you for your support along the way~[/h3]

notes.title: Development update! about the Free DLC
notes.notes:
[h3]Some of our fans might already figure out,
yes! The underdevelopment DLC character is the convenience store/mystery shop clerk! and this time we will provide new art style and new game play!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/dee6b7572bd050f8058e92dfa86d72a77860892c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/897fa257fd0bb74eca011de2c2ffc0e0fa95c64b.png[/img]
▲The “interact” icon will reveal once you reach a certain condition.

Unlike other characters, the interaction with the clerk will be seen as full screen this time! please look forward to it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/5cd9f4ab6900f4b545b192cff82fe2f5037cfc62.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/f4ab948f5157c692205c311501104c3419b78283.gif[/img]
▲a sample screenshot of the new gameplay. A new UI will be added in the next version.

The artwork is nearly finished, should be done by mid-April, followed by some adjustment and game play development, hopefully be out in the following month?

Since it is a completely new character and has two forms, the development time will be a little longer than we originally estimated, but we hope it will be worth waiting for!!

▲This is one of the mini game you need to challenge with the shop clerk, can anyone find out what is this game about?

Stay tuned with us and hopefully  you guys will like the new update!(๑•ั็ω•็ั๑)[/h3]
